span.p:
Sorawick Online University
sets three kinds of door

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 240px; text-align: center; width: 240px;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 240px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 240px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 240px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Owned and operated
by the university,
in front of its own Drive

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 240px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Faculty co-worker agent visits
with a Shōkai visitor card
and a mandate: one course,
one week, read and summarize

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 240px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Every visit that touches
a student's work is recorded
and visible to that student

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 240px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Host representative: the same
agent that designed the course,
now operating it

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 240px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Students' representatives visit
for materials, questions
and guidance, within the pass

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 240px; text-align: center;

span.p:
At enrollment, each student
gets or brings a representative
and signs its visitor card

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 240px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Practices with it all term,
and keeps it for other doors
